frame.treatment: Continuous even flat golden-yellow frame, no bevel or shadow

factual_anchors: This is an original imaginary editorial concept, not a named real location or an archival photograph
Only the scene and exact text specified for this example
allowed_changes: Compose the new original scene and adjust crop/light to achieve the specified cover
Optically refine text within its designated zone while retaining exact characters
forbidden_changes: Recognizable famous landmarks or named real buildings
People, vehicles, flags or animals unless explicitly requested
Extra text, fake captions, barcodes, dates, numbers, logos
Detached rectangular title panels or decorative geometric mountains
review_checks: One immediate visual focus at 200px wide
Exact Chinese characters and intended line order
Source image retains tangible photographic depth/material
Masthead and headline have different functions and strong local contrast
No accidental collision of text and important subject features
content_promise: 把目光集中到岩石层理和表面的变化，示范单一物件与摄影微距。

direction.why_this_image: One rounded dark stone and its naturally exposed layered face supply form, texture and a readable contour.
direction.rejected_route: wide landscape with many small stones
direction.why_rejected: At thumbnail size neither the tactile subject nor the editorial focus would survive.

art_direction.subject: A single dark slate-like river-worn stone with a revealed striated edge on a pale mineral surface, original conceptual still-life photography, no fossil or artifact claims.
art_direction.camera: Close macro still-life, low three-quarter viewpoint, 85mm equivalent, physically credible depth of field; main face in focus.
art_direction.subject_scale: One stone occupies central/lower 65% of image width; naturally pale upper surface leaves masthead space.
art_direction.foreground: Pale fine-grained mineral surface entering bottom edge with modest scattered grains only.
art_direction.middle_ground: Dark rounded stone dominates from center left to right, cut edge showing delicate lamination and tiny light-catching chips.
art_direction.background: Quiet pale grey mineral surface extending upward, natural continuous photographic background, not a graphic paper card.
art_direction.eye_path: Dark masthead at top -> raking highlight along rock edge -> large ivory title across lower dark stone face.
art_direction.light: One soft low grazing side light, rich but open shadow, subtle reflected fill.
art_direction.palette: Charcoal slate, warm limestone grey, ivory lettering, muted gold frame; minimal saturation.
art_direction.texture: Extremely tangible photographic mineral grain and lamination, sharp without artificial crunch, no painted or plastic surface.

text.font_character: Large distinctive Chinese Song/Mincho serif, confident broad strokes, fine stroke contrast, optically spaced; original masthead occupies roughly two thirds of width.
text.contrast_plan: Deep charcoal masthead on calm light-grey mineral surface.

text.font_character: One wide line of strong ivory Chinese Song serif; retain full glyph widths, fewer words with very large scale.
text.contrast_plan: Reserve the lower continuous dark stone face beneath every character, including the thinnest strokes.
